svg.title: How a request moves through DriveIQ
svg.desc: Animated diagram: the browser's request passes Cloudflare Access, the DriveIQ Worker verifies the Access token, then uses Workers AI, Vectorize, D1 and AI Gateway with Claude to answer, and serves page images from R2.
svg.text: How a request moves through DriveIQ
Everything below runs in your own Cloudflare account. Only Claude sits outside it.
an image of every document page

g.text: You open DriveIQ. The request reaches Cloudflare before it reaches the app.
Access signs you in, then adds a signed token to every request.
The Worker checks that token itself. No valid token, no data.
It embeds your question and searches your documents for it.
It reads your vehicle, service history, schedule and recent chat.
Claude writes the answer through your AI Gateway.
The answer comes back with the pages it used.
The page thumbnails are served from your R2 bucket.
